# openssh — 2012 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

### CVE-2012-5975
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2012-12-04 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 23082: (SSH.com Communications) SSH Tectia (SSH < 2.0-6.1.9.95 / Tectia 6.1.9.95) - Remote Authentication Bypass (remote/linux, 2012-12-02, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 23156: (SSH.com Communications) SSH Tectia - USERAUTH Change Request Password Reset (Metasploit) (remote/unix, 2012-12-05, verified=1)

The SSH USERAUTH CHANGE REQUEST feature in SSH Tectia Server 6.0.4 through 6.0.20, 6.1.0 through 6.1.12, 6.2.0 through 6.2.5, and 6.3.0 through 6.3.2 on UNIX and Linux, when old-style password authentication is enabled, allows remote attackers to bypass authentication via a crafted session involving entry of blank passwords, as demonstrated by a root login session from a modified OpenSSH client with an added input_userauth_passwd_changereq call in sshconnect2.c.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2012-6066
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2012-12-04 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 23079: freeFTPd 1.2.6 - Remote Authentication Bypass (remote/windows, 2012-12-02, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 24133: freeSSHd 1.2.6 - Authentication Bypass (Metasploit) (remote/windows, 2013-01-15, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 23080: freeSSHd 2.1.3 - Remote Authentication Bypass (remote/windows, 2012-12-02, verified=1)

freeSSHd.exe in freeSSHd through 1.2.6 allows remote attackers to bypass authentication via a crafted session, as demonstrated by an OpenSSH client with modified versions of ssh.c and sshconnect2.c.
